name: WordPress WooCommerce Self-Hosted
description: WooCommerce is an open-source commerce platform for WordPress that supports products, storefronts, carts, checkout, payments, orders, customers, shipping, taxes, and extensions on customer-operated sites.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact public HTTPS URL for a customer-owned WordPress WooCommerce store and one selected published product ID. Relay uses only the unauthenticated Store API GET for that exact product and exposes its ID plus purchasable, in-stock, and on-sale flags while excluding names, descriptions, SKUs, prices, images, categories, attributes, ratings, links, carts, checkout, customers, orders, settings, WordPress administration, broader browsing, and all mutations.

credentialRequirements.name: WORDPRESS_WOOCOMMERCE_STORE_BASE_URL
credentialRequirements.label: WooCommerce HTTPS store base URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact public HTTPS URL for one customer-owned WordPress store, including its install path if present; Relay rejects embedded credentials, unsafe paths, private DNS, queries, and fragments.

credentialRequirements.name: WORDPRESS_WOOCOMMERCE_PRODUCT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Selected public product ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: The exact positive numeric ID of the single published product Relay may inspect through the public Store API.

capabilities.label: Read selected product availability
capabilities.description: Read only one selected public product's ID and purchasable, in-stock, and on-sale flags without product copy, pricing, imagery, taxonomy, links, cart data, or private store data.

allowed.label: Read selected product availability
allowed.description: Read only one selected public product's ID and purchasable, in-stock, and on-sale flags.

blocked.label: Expose private store or product content
blocked.description: Names, slugs, SKUs, descriptions, prices, images, categories, attributes, ratings, links, cart details, customer data, orders, and private store data are excluded.

blocked.label: Mutate WooCommerce or WordPress
blocked.description: Cart, checkout, orders, customers, products, coupons, settings, plugins, themes, content, users, files, and every other mutation are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad store access
blocked.description: Other products, lists, search, filters, collections, categories, reviews, carts, checkout, orders, arbitrary paths or queries, redirects, and bulk access are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Public Product Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected public product's availability flags; content, pricing, customers, orders, carts, broader access, administration, and mutations remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: No Access
approvalProfiles.description: Expose no WordPress WooCommerce Self-Hosted actions.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway stores two nonsecret selected boundaries and mounts exactly one unauthenticated fixed public product GET.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer-owned WooCommerce staging store reachable at an exact public HTTPS URL and one published product ID are required. No authorized staging store is available in this worker lane.
providerSetup.nextAction: The external setup lane must nominate a staging store and exact published product ID, record only those nonsecret boundaries in Railway, then validate the projected Store API read, public-DNS/base-path/fixed-product enforcement, content and pricing redaction, unavailable-product behavior, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax. No WooCommerce keys, WordPress account, provider console, or consent are required.

evidence.supports: WooCommerce documents the Store API as an unauthenticated public JSON API under /wp-json/wc/store/v1, distinct from the authenticated WC REST API and customer/order administration.

WooCommerce documents GET /products/:id for one published product and response fields including id, is_purchasable, is_in_stock, is_on_sale, product content, prices, images, and links; Relay retains only the bounded availability projection.
WordPress documents /wp-json as the normal REST base and namespaced resource paths; Relay appends only the fixed WooCommerce Store API namespace to the validated store base URL.
